## Progress

- Merged [PR #62](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/62): P-01 board at /front-desk (7 columns with counts and a CTA each, nonclinical cards: reason category only, "Registration incomplete", wait timer on the server clock); check-in in two taps with a name + date-of-birth identity check; check-in time recorded as `medvya.front_desk.check_in.duration` (exit gate 3)
- Server-side state machine (one step forward, else 409); each move is a conditional update + VisitStatusEvent in one transaction, so a repeat or a second desk never checks in twice (8 concurrent check-ins on SQL Server → one event); audited endpoints; board payload tested against an exact field allowlist; mutation-checked (guard, idempotency, conditional update, payload, roles); browser-verified (en, ar RTL, keyboard, axe, 200 % zoom, tablet)
- Payment on Billing cards follows the `billing.invoices` flag: off (all of P1) a disabled placeholder, on a link to Billing (P4); merged with main after #59 and #58 landed
- Real-time updates and the call-in room: [PR #83](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/83) (MDV-P1-029), browser-verified against the real API with sign-in issuing the tenant and facility claims (MDV-P0-012)
- Left: waitlist (MDV-P1-027); workload panel (MDV-P1-030); walk-in is MDV-P1-025 (PR #89)

## Description

/front-desk board for today: Booked → Checked in → With nurse → Ready for doctor → In consult → Billing → Done with counts. Card shows name, time, doctor/visit type and nonclinical tags; CTA per column (Check in, Send to nurse, Intake done, Call in, Consult done, Payment received). "Receptionist view hides clinical notes" banner. Check-in for a returning patient: find appointment → confirm identity (name + DOB) → mark arrived, flag incomplete registration.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** A returning patient with an appointment can be checked in with ≤ 3 interactions; median check-in time is instrumented from arrival click to checked-in (exit gate 3 measurement).
- [ ] **AC2.** Column transitions follow the visit state machine; invalid moves are rejected server-side.
- [ ] **AC3.** Cards never show clinical information (reason shown only as category); verified by a security test on the board API payload.
- [ ] **AC4.** Billing column exists but payment actions are placeholders until P4 (feature flag).
- [ ] **AC5.** Board works at tablet width (horizontal scroll per responsive rules).
